'''James Bottoms Bink's version of The Pile''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[James Bottoms]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21786">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21786 Bink's version of The Pile], DeckTech (James "J.J.Binks" Bottoms, 27 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21786/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21786/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[James Bottoms]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Bink's version of The Pile''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 TSQ Bottoms LS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Well it is a pile. Played just like Hayes,but Bink's style.

== Original post ==

'''Bink's version of The Pile'''
* '''Author:''' James "J.J.Binks" Bottoms
* '''Published:''' February 27, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Well it is a pile. Played just like Hayes,but Bink's style.

=== Strategy ===

Play it like Hayes.So go read his Strategy.His strategy is alot better to understand and is the same way mine would be. Some cards are different from his,because they don't fit my style.
